shpendkelmendi.name: Shpend Kelmendi
shpendkelmendi.title: Software Engineer & Architect
shpendkelmendi.description: Shpend Kelmendi is a Software Engineer and Cloud Architect. His playground: Azure, DevOps, and cloud architecture. As a Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT), he shares what he learns and helps others succeed in the cloud.

joachimjabs.name: Joachim Jabs
joachimjabs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer & Cloud Architect
joachimjabs.description: Senior DevOps Engineer & Cloud Architect at bbv Software Services AG. With a passion for cloud technologies, Joachim specializes in designing and implementing scalable solutions. He is an advocate for DevOps practices and enjoys sharing his knowledge through blogging and speaking engagements.

jeremymeier.name: Jeremy Meier
jeremymeier.title: Software Engineer
jeremymeier.description: Jeremy Meier is a software engineer with bbv Software Services AG. He is convinced that software quality is a key ingredient of successful products. For that reason he teaches and shares experience with anyone willing to learn about designing a software system.

vanescoboehm.name: Vanesco Böhm
vanescoboehm.title: Software Engineer
vanescoboehm.description: Vanesco Böhm is an agile software engineer at bbv Software Services AG. His focus lies on cloud and web technologies, particularly .NET, Azure, and Azure DevOps. He continuously expands his expertise in these areas, as well as in software architecture.

oliverwith.name: Oliver With
oliverwith.title: Senior Software Engineer
oliverwith.description: Oliver With  is a Senior Software Engineer and Embedded Software Specialist. He is enthusiastic about Rust because it is the first language to combine memory safety, performance, and developer experience.

davidchristen.name: David Christen
davidchristen.title: Software Engineer & Architect
davidchristen.description: David Christen is a Professional Software Architect at bbv Software Services AG. He helps customers in the industrial sector design and implement .NET solutions, with a focus on clean architecture, event-driven systems, and software modernization. He treats simplicity as a craft, not a coincidence. As a coach, he shares his experience through reviews, pair programming, and training — convinced that great software is built by teams that learn together.

sebastianhans.name: Sebastian Hans
sebastianhans.title: Senior Software Engineer & Architect
sebastianhans.description: Sebastian Hans is a Senior Software Engineer and Architect at bbv Software Services GmbH. Having worked in different roles and with a variety of technologies, he believes that the technology itself is not actually that important. His focus is on quality and the socio-technical aspects of software development.

mobamoh.name: Mohamed Bamoh
mobamoh.title: Senior Technical Consultant & Solution Architect
mobamoh.description: Mohamed Bamoh is a Senior Technical Consultant and Solution Architect at bbv Software Services GmbH with 14+ years of experience across software engineering, architecture, and consulting. His background ranges from enterprise SAP Commerce and Java/Spring platforms to cloud-native Go systems on Kubernetes. He focuses on pragmatic software architecture, Domain-Driven Design, API-first engineering, and modern development approaches such as agentic and spec-driven software engineering.
